name: Reggaeton sub tresillo
desc: Modern perreo sub-bass: a round FM sine locked to the 3+3+2 tresillo via @3 @3 @2 elongation, walking an i-VI-iv-V root progression in G minor that alternates each cycle. Dark and clubby; full adds octave pops, peak runs quick two-note approaches into each tied anticipation.

code.sparse: note("<[g1@3 g1@3 g1@2] [c2@3 c2@3 c2@2] [eb1@3 eb1@3 eb1@2] [d2@3 d2@3 d2@2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).attack(.01).decay(.3).sustain(.6).release(.12).shape(.2).gain(${gain}*.9).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<[g1@3 g2@3 g1@2] [c2@3 c3@3 c2@2] [eb1@3 eb2@3 eb1@2] [d2@3 d3@3 d2@2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).attack(.008).decay(.3).sustain(.55).release(.14).shape(.25).gain(${gain}).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[g1@3 [g2 bb2]@3 [d2 f2]@2] [c2@3 [c3 eb3]@3 [g2 bb1]@2] [eb1@3 [eb2 g2]@3 [bb1 c2]@2] [d2@3 [d3 f3]@3 [a1 c2]@2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fm(${fm}).fmh(2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).attack(.006).decay(.28).sustain(.5).release(.14).shape(.3).gain(${gain}).room(.1).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
